# TFT Video Guide — Robinsongz's Ultimate Patch 16.6 Flowchart! (what to play from every spot)
Channel: robinsongz - TFT | Date: 2026-03-07
Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CXuCH4nlsxY

This document summarizes actionable gameplay advice and meta analysis from the provided TFT guide video for Patch 16.6. Augment-specific advice has been excluded.

## Comp Recommendations

### Noxus (Tempo/Fast 9)
*   **Strategy:** Aim for a win streak with an AP opener to enable a fast 9 strategy. (02:00)
*   **Early Game:** Play around Leblanc (equipped with Nashor's Tooth, Jeweled Gauntlet), Briar, Kabuko, a random Invoker, and a random Bruiser. (02:20)
*   **Mid Game (Level 6):** Play Kabuko, Kira, and Anivia, or a 4-Invoker setup. (02:40)
*   **Level 8 Transition:** Roll for vertical Noxus, aiming for 7 Noxus plus Kabuko. You can easily transition by dropping Embesa for Mel. (03:00)
*   **Late Game Pivot:** Transfer items to Mel. Proceed to level 9. (03:20)
*   **Late Game Cap (Azir):** If you hit Azir, pivot to him. Drop Darius and Briar from your board. Shyvana pairs well with Juggernaut units. (03:40)
*   **Late Game Cap (Rise):** Unlock Sylas by strategically holding Garen, Swain, Shyvana, Azir, Renekton, Rise, and Senna. The ultimate capped board includes Azir, Mel, and Sylas. Rise 
is easily unlocked for free if you are playing Shurima. (04:40)

### Demacia (Tempo/Fast 9)
*   **Opener:** Start with Jarvan, Sona, and Poppy. (05:30)
*   **Items:** Use Nashor's Tooth and Jeweled Gauntlet for tempo. (05:40)
*   **Level 8 Board:** Play Garen, Lux, one Invoker (e.g., Swain or Lissandra), and Galio. Prioritize achieving 7 Demacia. (06:00)
*   **Level 9 Transition:** Go to level 9. Unlock Kenan. Drop Jarvan. Play around Kenan, Xayah, Poppy, and Galio. (06:40)
*   **Late Game Pivot:** Transfer Lux's items to Rise. You can easily pivot to Sylas by selling Garen. (07:10)
*   **Cap:** The capped board features Demacia Rise with Kenan, Xayah, Poppy, Galio, Rise, Sylas, Senna, and an additional Warden. (07:10)

### Ionia (Win Streak/Tempo)
*   **Strategy (Strong Opener):** If you have a strong Ionia opener and are win streaking, play 5 Ionia (Yasuo, Jin, Shen, Irelia, Sett) to aim for a top 4 finish. (07:45)
*   **Items:** Guinsoo's Rageblade, Infinity Edge. (08:00)
*   **Level 9 Cap:** Pivot to Kindred, Shyvana, and Lucian at level 9. (08:10)
*   **Condition:** Typically, Ionia is played from a lose streak to enable rolling on level 7 for Yasuo 2-star. Win streak Ionia is considered "tempo Ionia." (08:40)
*   **Yasuo 2-star Condition:** If you naturally hit Yasuo 2-star, play 7 Ionia (Yasuo, Irelia, Sett). (09:00)
*   **Item Caution:** Yasuo requires specific items (Guinsoo's Rageblade, Titan's Resolve, Bloodthirster). Do not commit to building these items unless you are confident in hitting Yasuo 2-star. (09:15)

### Bilgewater
*   **Opener Condition:** Play Bilgewater only if you hit Illaoi 2-star and TF early. Unlock Graves. (09:45)
*   **Mid Game:** Try to naturally find Gangplank or Nautilus. Aim for 5 Bilgewater. (10:00)
*   **Stage 4 Pivot:** If you hit Lucian or Senna on a Stage 4 roll, immediately drop Graves and stop pursuing 7 Bilgewater. (10:15)
*   **Max Cap:** Drop Graves, Shen, and Illaoi. Play Tahm Kench, Wukong, and Shyvana. (10:40)
*   **Fizz Items:** If you have Fizz items, play Fizz. Otherwise, consider Volibear for Bruiser synergy. (10:55)
*   **Late Game:** Aim to play as many legendaries as possible. (11:10)

### Shadow Isle (Tempo & Lose Streak)
*   **Opener:** Start with Shadow Isle Viego (holding Kalista's items), ideally with Yoro 2-star, one Warden (e.g., Nautilus or Xayah), and a Quickdraw unit. (11:45)
*   **Strategy:** Play the strongest board possible until level 8. (12:00)
*   **Level 8 Board:** Lissandra, Seraphine, Kalista, Embesa, Thresh, Braum, Gwen. (12:15)
*   **Level 8 Pivot:** If you hit Azir, drop Gwen (or Braum/Yoro). If you hit Fiddlesticks, drop Embesa. (12:30)
*   **Level 9 Cap:** Go to level 9. Drop Gwen. Play Azir. Drop Yoro. Play Rise (Rise can be unlocked for free with Shurima synergy). You can also play Trickster, Renekton, and Nasus. (13:10)
*   **Tempo Condition:** Play tempo Shadow Isle only if you hit Viego 2-star or Yoro 2-star early. (13:40)
*   **Lose Streak Strategy:** Shadow Isle can be played from a lose streak (e.g., if you have an item-based econ start). Open with 4 Shadow Isle. (13:50)

### Orianna Opener (Lissandra Seraphine)
*   **Opener:** Orianna, Vi, Jarvan, Anivia. (14:15)
*   **Transition:** Lissandra, Seraphine. Drop Lissandra, Braum. Drop Sejuani. (14:30)
*   **Plus One Unit:** Add a plus one unit (Trickster is generally better than Maokai; Azir 1-star is the best option). (14:40)
*   **Late Game Strategy:** If playing Lissandra Seraphine, aim for a top 4 finish by donkey rolling on level 8. Do not pivot to Rise if you already have two AP carries. If you can reach level 9, cap your board with Shurima units (e.g., Zilean). (15:30)

### Slayer
*   **Condition:** This comp is rare nowadays. (16:05)
*   **Carry Options:** Slayer, Yona, or Embesa carry. Yona is stronger if you have Yasuo 2-star. (16:15)
*   **Opener:** Kiana, Briar, Blitzcrank, Cho'Gath/Rex'sai. (16:25)
*   **Transition:** Embesa, Rift Herald (Rift Herald is now easily accessible). (16:35)
*   **Traditional Cap:** Sion, Swain, Bel'Veth, Gangplank, Nautilus. Add one more unit (e.g., Shyvana, Fiddlesticks, Senna). Often, players will run Cho'Gath and Rex'sai and then go to level 9. (17:00)
*   **New Yona Version (Harder):** Yasuo, Yona, Wukong, Rift Herald, Bel'Veth, Aatrox. You can add two more units (e.g., Trickster). This version requires a natural Yasuo 2-star. (17:30)*   **Yona Item Condition:** Build Yona items (Titan's Resolve, Bloodthirster) to unlock Aatrox, as this board is significantly weaker without Aatrox. (17:50)

### Yordle (Tempo/Fast 9 & Top 4)
*   **Opener:** Lulu, Rumble 2-star (this is the most important unit for the opener), Teemo, Poppy. (18:15)
*   **Teemo Items:** Stack Teemo with Nashor's Tooth and Jeweled Gauntlet. (18:25)
*   **Win Streak Strategy:** If win streaking, add Kabuko and Kenan. Play 6 Yordle on Stage 3, 8 Yordle on Stage 4. Then fast 9. (18:35)
*   **Annie Board:** Annie, Wukong, Sylas, Sett, Zilean, Senna, Tibbers. (19:00)
*   **Avoid:** Do not play the Rise/Ziggs board; it is difficult to achieve and not very effective. (19:20)
*   **Vex Condition:** If you obtain Rabadon's Deathcap, play Vex as your carry (8 Yordle + Vex). (19:45)
*   **Vex Strategy:** If you are not win streaking or do not have strong econ, play around Vex for a top 4 finish. (19:55)

### Reroll Lines (General Strategy)
*   **Meta:** More reroll comps are viable on this patch. (21:00)
*   **Econ Condition:** Most 3-cost rerolls require very strong econ to be successful. (21:50)
*   **Lose Streak Strategy:** Often, aim for an 8-loss streak into a full send on level 7 at 3-5. (22:15)
*   **Avoid Reroll if Streaking:** If you are win streaking, it's generally better to go to level 9 and play Rise rather than rerolling. (22:30)
*   **Purpose:** Reroll comps serve as an alternative strategy if you have no strong opener or are on a lose streak. (26:30)
*   **Caution:** Playing 3-cost reroll from a lose streak is risky unless you have very strong econ. (26:40)

### Ahri Reroll
*   **Board:** Ahri, Shen, Yasuo, Kenan, Wukong, Nico (6 Ionia). (23:25)
*   **Items:** Nashor's Tooth, Jeweled Gauntlet, Prize in the Bag. (23:40)
*   **Roll Strategy:** Roll for Ahri 3-star and Kenan 3-star. After hitting, push levels for Sett. (23:45)
*   **Vertical Ionia:** Vertical Ionia is generally a strong composition. (23:50)
*   **Invoker Setup:** Ahri can be played effectively with an Invoker setup (e.g., dropping Shen for Kabuko). (24:00)
*   **Alternative Exalted Board (Untested):** Ahri, Milio, Nico, Nidalee, Kabuko, Wukong, Kenan. Play this if you have an early Exalted opener and are completing the quest on Stage 2. (25:00)

### Aphelios Bard
*   **Condition:** Play this if you get Guinsoo's Rageblade and Aphelios early. (25:40)
*   **Board:** Nico, Vi, Lissandra, plus an additional Warden unit. (25:50)

### Maokai Zoe Leona Reroll
*   **Board:** Malzahar, Kog'Maw, Seraphine, Zoe, Leona, Vi, Nico. (26:10)
*   **Leona Item:** Gargoyle Stoneplate is extremely important on Leona. (26:15)
*   **Carry Items:** Nashor's Tooth, Jeweled Gauntlet. Gunblade is a good option if you do not have anti-heal or shred. (26:20)
*   **Roll Strategy:** Aim to 3-star Malzahar, Kog'Maw, and Zoe. Then, level up for Trickster. (26:25)

### Jinx Reroll
*   **Condition:** Play this comp if you have a Jinx item start. (26:25)
*   **Board:** Jinx, Warwick, Singed, Lissandra, Ashe, Braum, Vi. (26:30)
*   **Roll Strategy:** At level 7, roll for Jinx 3-star and Singed 3-star. (26:40)
*   **Late Game Pivot:** Level up for Senna, as she makes this board very strong. (26:45)

### Leblanc Reroll
*   **Condition:** Play this with a Sion Leblanc opener. You will not be fast 9'ing with this strategy. (26:50)
*   **Board:** Leblanc, Briar, Swain, Darius, Sion, Draven, Kabuko, Nico. (27:00)
*   **Roll Strategy:** Reroll for Leblanc 3-star, Kabuko 3-star, and either Draven 3-star or Darius 3-star. (27:00)

### Azir (Win Streak)
*   **Condition:** Play Azir if you have a win streak AP opener and naturally hit Trickster, Leona, Aphelios, and Zoe early. (27:20)

## Openers & Transitions

*   **Lose Streak Non-Reroll (General):**
    *   **Purpose:** These strategies are for situations where you have no strong reroll spot and no strong opener. (30:00)
    *   **Benefit:** These comps allow you to acquire a free 4-cost unit on Stage 3, which helps stabilize your board and enables a fast 9 strategy. (30:30)

*   **Shadow Isle (Lose Streak):**
    *   **Opener:** Yoro + Viego. (28:10)
    *   **Strategy:** Take strong econ. Go to level 7. At Stage 3-3, unlock Kalista. At Stage 4-1 or 4-2, unlock Thresh. Aim for Kalista 2-star. (28:20)

*   **Zuan (Lose Streak):**
    *   **Condition:** Ideally with a Jinx item start. (28:50)
    *   **Strategy:** Take strong econ. Go to level 7. Unlock Warwick and Singed. At Stage 4-2, aim for Warwick 2-star and Singed 2-star. Fast 9 from this position. (29:00)

*   **Void Opener (Lose Streak):**
    *   **Opener:** Kog'Maw 2-star, Cho'Gath. (29:30)
    *   **Strategy:** Take strong econ. Go to level 7. At Stage 3-3, unlock Kai'Sa and Rift Herald. At Stage 4-2, aim for Kai'Sa 2-star and Rift 2-star. Fast 9. (29:40)
    *   **Kai'Sa Items:** Only build AP items for Kai'Sa; AD is ineffective. (29:50)
    *   **Baron:** Play Baron if you have very strong econ. (29:55)

*   **AD Win Streak:**
    *   **Strategy:** If you have an AD opener and are win streaking with strong econ, aim for a Kindred Senna fast 9. (31:10)

## General Strategy Tips

*   **Flowchart TFT:** Adopt a playstyle where your early game opener and items dictate a pre-planned path through mid-game and late-game, simplifying decision-making. (00:00)
*   **Prioritize Fast 9 if Streaking:** If you are on a strong win streak, it's generally more beneficial to push for level 9 and play strong legendary units like Rise, rather than committing to reroll strategies. (22:30)

## Patch-Specific Changes

*   **Reroll Comps:** There are more reroll compositions that are viable on this patch (16.6). (21:00)
*   **Rift Herald:** Rift Herald is now easily accessible/free, making comps that utilize it stronger. (16:35)
